## C2 - Confusables and KG hints, Section Twelve Driver Safety

FACT_ID: sec12-R01 | anchor: A01
Self-evaluation pairs trusted-observer feedback against professional lessons, reexamination pairs condition-or-record triggers against never-age rules with physician, officer, and family referrals on form DS 699, cognitive disorders pair diagnosis lists against mandatory Driver Safety reviews, and DMV answers range from medical requests through tests and limited terms to instant suspension or nothing [A01].
Why it matters: group reexamination; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec12-F01, sec12-F02, sec12-F03, sec12-F04, sec12-F05 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0086]

FACT_ID: sec12-R02 | anchor: A02
Priority notices pair top-box checks against five-working-day contact clocks with automatic suspension as the miss penalty, incapacity evidence pairs violation context against danger judgments with officer paperwork duties, non-compliance pairs code sections against suspension-till-pass rules, and restrictions pair ability-matching against condition-only tailoring across devices, limits, glasses, and mirrors [A02].
Why it matters: group priority-restrictions; difficulty high; prereq sec12-R01; confusables sec12-F06, sec12-F07, sec12-F08, sec12-F09, sec12-F10, sec12-F11 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0087]
